items.title: What Is DuPont (DD) Signaling With Its New Peptide Purification Product?
items.summary: DuPont de Nemours (NYSE:DD) has introduced AmberChrom SIL silica gel to broaden its bioprocessing purification offerings for peptide drugs. The new silica gel is aimed at purification steps in peptide therapeutic manufacturing, including treatments for chronic diabetes and obesity. AmberChrom SIL targets drug makers and contract manufacturers that are increasing capacity for complex biopharmaceutical production workflows.
